description: Run a security scan of a project. Writes results into .security-scan/ and never modifies your source.

budget_s.description: Seconds the Scanners may take together (default 300). Past it, nothing new starts, what is running is stopped, and the result is reported incomplete with the cut Scanners named. 0 for none.

profile.description: offline (the default) runs every Scanner that works with no network access. full adds a second advisory source and the dependency-reality Check, both of which send package names to public registries.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the project to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

name: scan

description: List findings from the last scan, worst first. Bounded by default.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the project to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

name: list_findings

description: Full detail for one finding: evidence, exploitation, dependency path and which scanner reported it.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the project to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

name: explain_finding

description: What the last scan actually did: which scanners ran, which failed, and whether the result is complete.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the project to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

name: scan_status

description: Stop a running scan: its containers are killed, nothing is written, and the previous results (if any) stand. What Ctrl-C does on the command line.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the project to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

name: scan_cancel

description: Check that this machine can scan, before scanning: the container runtime, the image, the vulnerability database, the package-name index, SELinux, TLS trust, and which MCP client configuration names valvur. One line per check with the fix on any that would fail a scan. Changes nothing.

network.description: Also probe, with one bounded TCP connect per host, whether the registries a first run and the full profile need are reachable from here. Off by default: without it doctor opens no socket.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the project to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

name: doctor
